Trend pullback (15m entries, 1h trend)

The method picked by the November 2026 scalping research: the only candidate that stayed positive after realistic costs in our own tests. Trade only in the direction of the 1-hour trend (price beyond a rising or falling 200 EMA). On the 15-minute chart, wait until the 9, 21 and 50 EMAs are stacked in that direction, let price pull back to the 21 EMA, and enter when a bar closes back across the 9 EMA. Stop 2.5 ATR away, target twice the risk, London and New York hours only, at most two trades a day. Trades last hours, not minutes: on gold, anything faster gave its edge to the spread.

Evidence: Weak, own backtest only: +0.21R per trade (95% interval +0.01 to +0.41) after costs on Jan 2025 - May 2026, 215 trades, profit factor 1.15; flat in early 2026; no independent published test on gold. Treat as a hypothesis to test at minimum size.
